lockedFeatures: squared (level, straight) hem running dead flat across the full width on both sides of the vent
side vent at the side seam with a vertical left panel edge and a flaring right panel edge
rectangular bar tack stitched across the top of the vent, as drawn
topstitched hem allowance along the whole hem
matched framing: garment square to camera, whole shirt bottom at a standard distance so measurement siblings can be compared side by side
notes: Three attempts, budget spent. Attempt 1: vent roughly twice its drawn length, no bar tack, tight three-quarter crop - rejected. Attempt 2: bar tack restored, hems levelled, matched framing restored, vent still long - rejected by the gate on dimensions. Attempt 3: same construction retained and the slit shortened again; the vent-edge diagonal is slightly flatter than attempt 2. Attempts 2 and 3 are close in quality - attempt 3 is better on vent length and framing, attempt 2 is better on the vent-edge angle. Both candidates remain on disk for a human to choose between.
